EmailTemplate.subject: Thank You
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Insert Name],
Thank you for being a part of the American Red Cross Heroes Saving Lives program.
From its founding, the Red Cross has been dedicated to serving members of the military, veterans and their families, and that commitment never waivers. Together we share a mission of helping to save lives and we appreciate the opportunity to partner with [Company Name].
You can take pride in knowing that your partnership with us makes a positive impact on your local community — and even those far away. Families and communities depend on the Red Cross in times of need; and we depend on the support of partners, like you, to help fulfill the mission of saving lives.
Your Heroes Saving Lives blood drive took place on [date] and had a goal of [units], you collected a total of [XX] units, each of which can impact more than one life.
We rely on blood drive partnerships throughout the year. Thank you for offering this opportunity to your group to help ensure a safe national blood supply. We appreciate you and hope we can partner again in the future.
Sincerely,
[Insert Name]
